description: Multi-Tenant Phase 4F.1 -- the canonical Blob key layout for a BLOB-mode tenant's durable storage. Both dashboard/api/_lib/tenantBlobKeys.js (Node) and tenant_blob_keys.py (Python) must compute the LITERAL SAME keys from the same tenantId -- this fixture is the shared contract both languages' test suites validate their own formula against.
notes: relPath validation is defense-in-depth only -- the primary guard against a malformed relPath is each caller's own allowlist (e.g. data.js's buildRequestedRelPath()).
